$comment: Max gzipped first-load JS per route, in KB. Checked by `bun run bundle:check` in the pre-push hook. Set from measured sizes + ~10% headroom; lower them as you trim. Oct 2026 growth vs the previous build: the dashboard shell +1.3 KB, most routes +2-3 KB from shared code split into more chunks, and /dashboard/examples/tables/users +13.8 KB (433.2 -> 447.0) because Turbopack now emits the @/lib/form field components (field, checkbox, radio, switch, toggle-group) twice, in the loading.tsx shell chunk and the page chunk.
